# Network policy

## Browser connect sources

- `'self'`
- `blob:`
- `https:`
- `https://api.github.com`
- `https://arxiv.org`
- `https://www.arxiv.org`
- `https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org`
- `https://ar5iv.org`
- `https://openreview.net`
- `https://*.workers.dev`
- `http://localhost:*`
- `http://127.0.0.1:*`

Browser HTTPS supports ingestion; loopback HTTP supports the paired bridge.

## Fetch-proxy hosts

- `arxiv.org`
- `www.arxiv.org`
- `ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org`
- `ar5iv.org`
- `openreview.net`

The proxy list is a separate server-side SSRF boundary and is intentionally narrow.
